title: A year of periods
about: The bed's year as the map splits it: a growing period from its target, harvest, the next period with other plant sets, then the rest with its cover crop and the worm box wrapped for winter. A rehearsal: nothing is written into your habitat.

steps.title: Robot: sow the period's target
steps.why: The first period's cells, sown as the weather allows.

steps.title: The season grows
steps.why: Weeks pass in minutes. Keep confirming what the robot proposes: water, feed, look for weeds.

steps.title: You: harvest
steps.why: What is ready comes out; the cells are free.

steps.title: The period ends
steps.why: When its last month is over, Control asks you to clear what still stands and to move on to the next period.

steps.title: You: clear and move on
steps.why: What stands comes out, and the next period's target becomes the plan: other plant sets, or the winter rest.
